svg.title: Villa — Basement
svg.metadata: Layout reference: https://www.stratbook.gg/assets/rainbow-six/maps/svg/villa/villa-basement.svg ; monochrome adaptation for SiegeMaps, 2026-10-28 JST. Layout not verified in game. 2026-10-28: aligned to the frame of the Villa 1F/2F images, garage east opening moved 0.9 m north and the north-east exterior stair added, from replay movement.
